caption: Puma Biotechnology, Inc. v. Sandoz Inc.
citation_line: Puma Biotechnology, Inc. v. Sandoz Inc., No. 1:21-cv-19918, ECF No. 89 (D.N.J. Dec. 20, 2022)
headnote_district_ruling: Denied without prejudice an unopposed request to redact and seal portions of a status-conference transcript in Hatch-Waxman litigation. Confidentiality designations and generalized competitive-harm claims did not satisfy the common-law right of access or Local Civil Rule 5.3.
qualification_rationale: A detailed checklist for sealing motions in commercially sensitive pharmaceutical litigation, including particularized injury, less-restrictive alternatives, consolidation, and competent evidentiary support.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive sealing order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Sealing and transcript-redaction order; it does not decide a claim, defense, remedy, or material merits issue.
